Subject: MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement next steps (Ariba/Coupa, W-9, banking details)

Hi Janelle — great to meet you and the Acme procurement team on the call earlier. Recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestone: getting Redwood set up in Ariba/Coupa, vendor forms + W-9, and banking details so PO and initial payments can flow.

High-level recap / next steps I captured:
- Milestone: Vendor onboarding & procurement (Ariba/Coupa supplier setup, vendor forms, W-9, banking details)
- Target close date: 2026-07-30 (folder: contract signature + supplier code assigned)
- Dependencies: Acme supplier onboarding (Ariba/Coupa), legal review of SOW, Redwood W-9 + banking info, PO issuance
- Responsibilities:
  - Acme procurement: initiate Ariba/Coupa supplier record, complete vendor questionnaire, issue PO
  - Acme finance: confirm banking details / preferred payment terms
  - Redwood (me + Camila): provide W-9, vendor packet, populate payment info in portal, support Ariba/Coupa steps

Attached: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx — this is a lightweight draft we can iterate on. Can you confirm who on your side will be the primary procurement and finance contacts for the Ariba/Coupa flow? Also let me know if Acme requires a Redwood legal redline before supplier setup (we can fast-track an initial PO if needed).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0126
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — nice to meet you as well. A couple quick Qs after reviewing the draft:

> Milestone: Vendor onboarding & procurement (Ariba/Coupa supplier setup, vendor forms, W-9, banking details)

1) Does Redwood have an existing supplier code in our Ariba instance? If not, we will need the vendor packet + W-9 uploaded to Ariba before we can assign a code.
2) We use Coupa for PO issuance in a handful of BU’s — is Redwood able to accept a Coupa-enabled supplier record or a standard supplier setup only?
3) For banking details, do you require a vendor portal upload or will a secure PDF be sufficient?

I'll loop in procurement@acme-corp.com once I confirm the right internal owner for the Ariba form. Our tentative timeline looks tight for 7/30 but feasible if we get docs this week.

Regards,
Janelle Ortiz

Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement next steps (Ariba/Coupa, W-9, banking details)

Hi Janelle — thanks for the questions. Quick answers and an updated MAP with more granular milestones attached (MAP_draft_v2.xlsx).

Answers:
- Ariba supplier code: Redwood does not currently have an Acme Ariba supplier code. We recommend Acme create the supplier record and then we will upload the vendor packet/W-9 directly in the Ariba supplier workspace. If your team prefers, we can also initiate the supplier onboarding by completing the supplier form on your behalf and sending the completed packet for your review.
- Coupa: We can accept Coupa-enabled supplier records. Our finance team supports Coupa punchout and standard supplier setups; please indicate which flow your BU prefers and we will follow that path.
- Banking details: secure PDF is acceptable for initial setup; final preferred method is entry into your portal (Ariba/Coupa). We will provide both PDF and portal-ready CSV if helpful.

Updated MAP highlights (key milestones, owner, target dates):
- 7/16: Acme assigns procurement owner for Ariba/Coupa supplier setup (Acme) — dependency: procurement lead identified
- 7/17–7/20: Acme opens supplier in Ariba/Coupa + uploads vendor packet (Acme)
- 7/20: Redwood submits signed W-9 + banking stub (Redwood) — dependency: internal Redwood finance approval
- 7/22: Acme issues PO / supplier code assigned (Acme)
- 7/30: Contract SOW executed and first invoice eligible (Target close)

Action items we can take immediately:
- I attached MAP_draft_v2.xlsx with rows for each milestone, owner, deliverable, and dependency.
- I’ll attach a short vendor setup instruction PDF (Vendor_Setup_Instructions.pdf) and the completed Redwood W-9 (W9_Acme_Submission.pdf) once I have finance sign-off; anticipated 7/20.

If that timeline works, Marissa — can you confirm that Acme procurement will be able to complete the supplier creation this week? Janelle, feel free to share the procurement contact and we’ll coordinate directly.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes | Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

-- Attachment: MAP_draft_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)
